svg.title: Self-Diagnosing Agent v2 architecture
svg.desc: A cost-aware control layer that gates diagnosis by risk, runs an abstaining shadow simulator, resolves a two-axis binary probe into a 2x2 fault table, and writes confirmed drifts into a persistent semantic memory that feeds back into belief formation.

g.text: Predict effect · split confidence: task vs effect
observed vs belief · vs shadow (only if not abstained)
A: description matches behavior? B: belief self-consistent?
no absolute label — two verifiable questions
confirmed drift → text rule · promote on recurrence · no training
